senses.gloss: m. (<cite ref="A01766"><he>אַל</he></cite> = <cite ref="P00757"><he>עַל</he></cite>, a. <cite ref="V00757"><he>תוס׳</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="V00244"><he>תּוּסְבְּרָא</he></cite>; cmp.
